paragraphs: Fortuna Health runs a digital service that helps people apply for and keep Medicaid and other government health coverage. It reaches consumers through providers and insurers rather than being offered directly to the public.

A person starts with a screening rather than a long form, and the site says an eligibility check can take as little as 30 seconds. From there the service guides the person through enrollment and renewal for the Medicaid programs that fit their circumstances. Status notifications follow each important administrative action, so deadlines are less likely to slip past unnoticed. The company states that every one of its navigators is certified and licensed to enroll. Live navigation is offered in more than one language.

Fortuna describes itself as modernizing the infrastructure for Medicaid and government health programs. Case studies on the site include Alomere Health System, described as cutting uncompensated care after working with Fortuna. The company says it is expanding nationwide.

quote.text: Everything you need for government coverage from enrollment to renewal.
